meta.name: Aloukik
meta.description: There are so many things happening in this world that have no explanation. Believe it or not, there is probably no one who doesn’t love ghost stories. There is a storyteller who would dictate his stories, while a girl would write it down. While writing those stories, the girl also gradually became haunted and then she was shocked. This series is about the surprises of the girl and the ghost stories told by the author.
